eve.text: Goldmeadow is where Maralen, as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, brings Ashling news of Isilu and Morcant's plot, and they travel to the kithkin village.
Ashling and the others fight the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves there, and Rhys catches Maralen and fatally strikes her with moonglove as their pact demanded.
Oko reveals that he orchestrated the ordeal and roused Isilu, and he cures his sister with dawnglow, and Eirdu appears to offset Isilu, rebalancing the plane's cycle.
Rhys, freed of the pact's magic, declines a new oath, bids Maralen farewell and fades into a shower of petals.
